verdict.rationale: FutureHouse/Edison is a hosted AI research platform that accepts user datasets and queries, so a training opt-out or no-training policy is a fair axis to judge. The evidence pack contains no mention of data-use, training opt-out, or privacy policy. It covers only agents, the API client, file uploads, and pricing tiers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
